verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that the reporting API uses a version-prefixed path (https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices), which suggests URL-based API versioning. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, version lifecycle or sunset commitments, so only the versioning half of the story is thinly supported. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning/compatibility guarantees, changelog notices of API deprecations, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), independent corroboration.
